g.text: The registry decides who may speak to the enclave
The registry rejects instructions from any other contract, and the taker's identity
is stamped from msg.sender — it cannot be forged.
Simulated-TEE caveat: attestation is magic_pass and the enclave's identity key
regenerates on every restart — a rebuild silently orphans the registration.
A four-check cron watches for exactly that drift, every 15 minutes.
